contract.intent: Adopt AgentsKit shell v1 on the public Harness site (bar, tour, footer, aurora, product wordmark) against the canonical six-product ecosystem, and dogfood Doc Bridge in CI, without changing the Harness product loop.

outOfScope: Harness product loop: running, activating or configuring it (.ak-harness, loop.config*)
Harness runtime behavior, public API, CLI and local operational UI (src/**)
Playbook as a seventh product in the bar or tour
push, pull request, release, npm publication, deployment, Vercel and DNS

outcomes.statement: Every page loads shell v1 from NEXT_PUBLIC_AGENTSKIT_SHELL_ORIGIN (default https://www.agentskit.io) with data-current=harness and data-current-repo=AgentsKit-io/harness; the bar lists exactly the six products and is the only place with a GitHub Star (targeting AgentsKit-io/harness); the home keeps its flow hero, renders <agentskit-aurora>, <agentskit-ecosystem current="harness"> and <agentskit-footer> with six-product static fallbacks; docs use the .ak-product-wordmark nav title; no console errors or horizontal overflow at 1440x960 and 390x844.

ecosystem.json matches the canonical AgentsKit catalog: six products shown in fixed order (AgentsKit, Registry, Chat, Doc Bridge, Code Review, Harness) and Playbook catalogued with showInBar=false; no retired public references.
doc-bridge.config.json is generated and valid, the committed .doc-bridge index is current, and the standard gate plus Documentation Standard v1 pass; CI runs the same commands.

logic.reason: No Harness runtime or business logic changes are in scope.

endpoint.reason: The public site is a static export; no service endpoint changes.

database.reason: No database-backed behavior is in scope.

cli.reason: No ak-harness or ak-verify command behavior changes.

mcp.reason: No MCP runtime behavior is in scope.

tracking.reason: No issue, PR, release or external tracking mutation is authorized for this task.

checks.command: pnpm -s docs:bridge:config:check && pnpm -s exec ak-docs validate-config >/dev/null && node -e 'console.log(JSON.stringify({status:"passed",criteria:["doc-bridge-dogfooding"]}))'
pnpm -s docs:bridge:index >/dev/null && git diff --exit-code -- doc-bridge.config.json .doc-bridge && node -e 'console.log(JSON.stringify({status:"passed",criteria:["doc-bridge-dogfooding"]}))'
